programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Back in San Diego and with Rockfish on the mind, the LK crew fish new grounds and depths to catch these iconic Southern California bottom fish. Along for the ride is pro snowboarder and friend Dave Downing to round out this epic rock cod fishing trip.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: With the drastic changes in the Southern California fishery over the past several years, it has been easy to get fixated on targeting large Bluefin tuna and going all out on what many have coined "big fish" fishing. On this episode Ali and Rush take advantage of the many other opportunities this time of year has to offer and switch focus back to the basics, targeting smaller yellowfin, bluefin, and mahi on bait.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Las Pobres Ilegales
programme.desc: Una joven huye de su casa por su padrastro y se va a los EE.UU., donde descubre el abuso a los indocumentados.

programme.title: El Día del Compadre
programme.desc: Durante la víspera del Día del Compadre, los habitantes de un condominio se preparan para festejar entre risas, juegos y riñas.

programme.title: Cinco Nacos Asaltan Las Vegas
programme.desc: Un burócrata desempleado y cuatro amigos viajan a Las Vegas para asaltar un casino.

programme.title: Santa Claus
programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Veneno para las Hadas
programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.title: Tráiganlos vivos o muertos
programme.desc: Una mujer roba un banco mientras su cómplice y amante dispara a los banqueros protegiéndola en su huida.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that the rambling roses have finished flowering, Monty turns his attention to pruning and tying in new growth for a good display next year. On the 20th anniversary of the death of Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost returns to the famous `Gardeners' World' location, Barnsdale, to pay tribute and to revisit some of his own early gardening memories. Also, we travel to Abergavenny to visit the garden of a sweet pea enthusiast to get her top tips for growing the best blooms.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Joe Swift pays a visit to the Northumberland garden of Chris Mullin who, after over twenty years as a Member of Parliament, has turned his attention to the renovation of his walled garden. And National Trust head gardener, Alan Power, catches up with the transformation of Shakespeare's New Place garden in Stratford-upon-Avon.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a 'drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. In the first of a five-part series about botany, Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that birds are no longer nesting in hedges, now is the time to get them looking trim and neat and Monty has plenty of tips on how to cut them so that they grow well. Alan Power visits Croome Park in Worcestershire to discover more about one of the first great landscapes of Capability Brown, and we visit a couple in Gloucestershire whose ornamental grass garden was inspired by the Far East.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the bank holiday ahead there's plenty of opportunity to catch up with some essential jobs in the garden and Monty gives a masterclass on how to look after and prune soft fruit to ensure maximum production next year. Frances Tophill is at RHS Rosemoor where she is catching up on her vegetable trials which she started earlier in the year, and Alan Power visits Hestercombe Gardens in Somerset to find out more about the discovery of a long-lost gladiolus.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the regular team are joined by some new faces offering tips, advice and inspiration from gardens large and small across the country. In this programme Monty is at Longmeadow catching up with some seasonal jobs, and also getting out and about for an inspiring visit to the longest herbaceous border in the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow giving advice on how to deal with unruly roses, taking cuttings of herbs and planting a new tree. Carol Klein continues her series on plant families, exploring some of the most popular relations of the rose, and we pay a visit to an orchard in Worcestershire to find out how enthusiasts are caring for one of the rose family members - the plum.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: September is the perfect time for planting and Monty adds some autumn flowering asters to his borders as well as refreshing his strawberry beds with new stock. Carol Klein continues her series on plant families and this week she takes a close look at one of the largest plant families in the world, the daisy family, and we pay a visit to a plant nursery in Hampshire, which specialises in growing plants - including many varieties of daisy - for attracting wildlife.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There's plenty of advice from Longmeadow this week, as Monty starts to tidy up the garden for autumn and reviews this year's display in the jewel garden. In the final part of Carol Klein's series on plant families she looks at the Apiaceae family, which includes not only stalwart and wildlife friendly plants but also edible roots; and we pay a visit to a giant vegetable grower in Nottinghamshire who is hoping to break the world record with his carrots.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty catches up with seasonal jobs at Longmeadow when he divides some perennials and plants alpines for spring colour. programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah runs a health check on two female cheetahs with veterinarian Maaike. She then goes into the wilderness with Naankuse founder Marlice. Together they go in search of the elephant Apollo, which was resettled in the sanctuary. The former "problem" elephant now leads a peaceful life here.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This unique arctic city is home over 2000 moose! And these notorious animals are running riot... Crossing busy highways, giving birth in backyards, and even doing battle, right here in suburbia! But life on the streets is fraught with danger...and in this expanding city, more highways mean more moose deaths. But the people of Anchorage are on a mission, to protect the most iconic animal in this Wild City.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In episode two we take a look at Maui and Moloka'i. In the middle of the archipelago they form the heart of Hawaii. The second largest island of Hawai'i - Maui - is a true paradise for surfers. Archie Kalepa was one of the first big wave surfers and is still chasing the thrill today. The ukulele represents the sound of the islands like no other instrument. Eric Devine has been building the plucked string instrument for 20 years. In Kula he goes in search of the perfect wood.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Elephant human conflict has been going on in India for decades. Only now it has increased because of the shrinking forests and the expanding human habitation. North Bengal with it's fragmented habitat of tea gardens, human habitation and paddy fields is a hot bed of conflict. We follow an elephant flying squad which is responsible for keeping the elephants away from these human dominated landscapes.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: Meet the Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Once marsupials were found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Cape Towns biggest storm in 2 decades, there's a whole lot of work to be done at the Two Oceans Aquarium! The pressure builds as nine Ragged-Toothed Sharks are on their way from East London for their introduction to the new, highly anticipated predator exhibit. Join the team in one last push to complete the giant tank in time for its incoming residents and see the experience the culmination of a year of hard work coming together, at the Two Oceans Aquarium!

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The tropical rainforests of Costa Rica provide an invaluable habitat to several emblematic species, such as jaguars, tapirs, white-lipped peccaries, spider monkeys, the very rear green macaw, amongst many others. Most of them are protected in national parks, reserves and wildlife refuges. However, the long-term survival of these ecosystems and of their biodiversity rely on the success of connecting wildlife populations throughout the country.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Imaginary
programme.desc: When Jessica moves back into her childhood home with her family, her youngest stepdaughter, Alice, finds a stuffed bear named Chauncey. As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: Sergeant Howie (Edward Woodward) arrives on the small Scottish island of Summerisle to investigate the report of a missing child. A conservative Christian, the policeman observes the residents' frivolous sexual displays and strange pagan rituals, particularly the temptations of Willow (Britt Ekland), daughter of the island magistrate, Lord Summerisle (Christopher Lee). The more Sergeant Howie learns about the islanders' strange practices, the closer he gets to tracking down the missing child.

programme.title: Cyborg Cop
programme.desc: When Jack receives a distress call from his brother, Phillip, he's forced to travel to the island of St. Keith in the Caribbean. As a former agent for the Drug Enforcement Administration, Jack investigates and discovers that mad scientist Kessel has been turning men into cyborgs and selling them as weapons on the black market. With his brother as one of the unfortunate victims, Jack must now stop Kessel and save the day.

Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

However, after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now, their expert climbing skills are put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

programme.title: Continue
programme.desc: Convinced she's fated to walk the same troubled path as her father, Dean suffers a major mental health episode and is committed to a rehabilitation facility. Once confined, Dean shudders through the agonies of recovery, and bravely comes out the other side armed with a defense against the darkness, summed up in one word: Continue.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor, and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house.

programme.title: Bad Moms
programme.desc: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: An ordinary woman who struggles with feelings of insecurity and inadequacy on a daily basis wakes from a fall believing she is suddenly the most beautiful and capable woman on the planet. With this newfound confidence, she is empowered to live her life fearlessly and flawlessly, but what will happen when she realizes her appearance never changed?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Rutledge, Georgia to investigate Camp Rutledge, a family friendly camp, that is anything but friendly at night. The call to help comes from a frightened mother, Melissa, who has attended the camp since she was 17 yrs, and now has a daughter old enough to start vacationing at the campsite. Melissa has witnessed many unexplained paranormal things, and wants to make sure it's safe before she takes her daughter there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Baton Rouge, Louisiana to investigate the Old State Capital Building. Built in 1852, this building has seen countless politicians come through its doors including congressman, Pierre Couvillon, who died during a heated debate opposing gambling. The building also survived the Civil War, during which the Union Army used the basement as a prison.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet's most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth's biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Britain failing to fall, the Blitz drew to a close, the sinking of the German battleship, the Bismarck, lifted the spirits of the British Navy. Hitler's campaign for Russia, Operation Barbarossa, got underway, the course of World War II changed.
programme.sub-title: The Blitz the Bismarck and Barbarossa: April-June 1941

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler had expected a decisive victory in Russia, he was thwarted at every turn and while the Luftwaffe bombed Moscow and the Siege of Leningrad began, the Soviet Red Army refused to capitulate. They just watched and waited for the winter snows.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: British artillery pounds German positions in northern France and troops advance through villages and care for civilians. Tanks clear mine fields. Part 2, American troops enter Cherbourg. The 6th Airborne Div. receives supplies by parachute from British planes. Gen. J.L. Collins accepts the surrender of German officers.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The episode explains the American capture of Strasbourg from the Germans followed by the German surprise attack on the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: Sinking Nazi Battleships: Bismarck & Tirpitz
programme.desc: When the Nazi Battleship Bismarck was launched it was destined to be one of the greatest battleships that ever took to sea. After it sunk the thought to be unsinkable HMS Hood, Winston Churchill uttered just three words - Sink the Bismarck.

programme.title: 1945-1953: From World War to Cold War
programme.desc: Hear how the Yalta Conference of 1945 - in which Franklin D Roosevelt, Winston Churchill and Joseph Stalin met to discuss Europe's post-war reorganization - led to enmity.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Yom Kippur War
programme.desc: Yom Kippur, the holiest day on the Jewish calendar. Israeli troops came under surprise attack by Syrian and Egyptian forces, ten times greater than their own. This time they learned to respect the courage and abilities of the armies, engaging in the biggest and bitterest tank battles since the second World War.

programme.title: Guy Martin: Battle Of Britain
programme.desc: Guy follows in the footsteps of the brave young pilots of World War Two. But his toughest test yet starts with a near disaster on take-off!

programme.title: The Ace's War
programme.desc: At the dawn of the 20th Century, the future of aviation is in the hands of a few visionaries and daredevils. In 1903 American brothers Wilbur and Orville Wright make four flights of a few dozen meters on a North Carolina beach. The age of the pioneers ends suddenly in 1914 with the outbreak of the First World War.

programme.title: Operation Plunder The Rhine Crossing
programme.desc: Part 1 shows fighting in Leipzig, Nuremberg, and Braunschweig. Includes shots of German prisoners and civilians. Shows Adolf Hitler speaking at Nuremberg in 1932. Part 2, Gen. Patton inspects troops. Shows the raising of the first official American flag to fly over Germany. Part 3 shows bodies of persons killed in German concentration camps and devices used for killing and torture.
programme.sub-title: ALLIES OVERRUN GERMAN DEFENSE OF THE RHINELAND

programme.title: Great Battles Of The Civil War: Volume 2
programme.desc: This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1863-1865. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler, Himmler, and the Occult
programme.desc: The link between Hitler, the esoteric mystical movement of the nineteenth century and the Aryan mythology of the Waffen SS is finally established. See how the surviving snippets of film and documentary evidence prove that Hitler and the Nazi movement were duped by a series of charlatans into creating a framework for a pseudo-religious new world order which was based solely on a series of frauds.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: In the early morning hours of the 17th of January 1991, coalition air forces unleashed a massive air assault on Iraqi forces in both Iraq and Kuwait. The magnitude of the coalition air offensive dealt a crushing blow to Iraq's air defense network.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: The continued dedication and bravery of the men and women of the air force brings about the collapse of the Third Reich and Germany's surrender. A new generation of super bombers is born out of America's latest technological leap, and, together with the ever more effective combat strategies, US Air Force missions help to bring down the curtain in the empire of the rising sun.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: Rise of a Demon
programme.desc: The story of Adolf Hitler during the pre-war years when the Nazi party exercised complete power over Germany is told using contemporary news reels.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: As peace negotiations dragged on, U.S. soldiers faced new threats and dangers - and a largely conscript army started to come apart under pressure. Once-censored film footage provides a shocking insight, from the carnage of Hamburger Hill to vicious fighting in the Mekong Delta.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The commanders of the First and Third American Army, General Omar Bradley and General George S. Patton Jr. are discussed.

programme.title: The Fall of Berlin
programme.desc: After many years of bitter fighting and destruction; Nazi Germany͛s once powerful ͚war machine' began to falter. As the allies at last made positive advances, Hitler͛s shattered armies started their weary retreat back towards the fatherland. Weakened by a relentless allied push on all fronts Hitler confines himself to Nazi capital city, Berlin.

programme.title: 444 Days: The Iran Hostage Crisis
programme.desc: It was a 444 days ordeal for the American diplomats taken hostage in Tehran. 444 days of humiliation for the most powerful nation in the world, the United States. In these 444 days, Iranian Islamists imposed their will on their country and the world. Rediscover the events of November 4, 1979 to January 20, 1981.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Covers the United States involvement with Korea and testing of Korean weapons. John Ford directed this film which is the only color documentary made during the Korean War.

programme.title: Operation Plunder The Rhine Crossing
programme.desc: This program covers the growth of German aggression, 1934-1940. Contains many animated maps explaining German tactics and many views of Adolf Hitler making speeches and in conferences. Shows a large Nazi rally and Axis-inspired riots in Belgium and France. Also shows a Nazi rally in Madison Square Garden. Included is footage of Joachim von Ribbentrop and Fritz Kuhn.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband's recipe Guy's Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole

programme.title: Mantis Under Falcon Claws
programme.desc: A silk dealer and a princess are traveling in the China country, when they are attacked by a group of Falcon bandits. The bandits kidnap the princess and steal the silk. The princess's father makes an effort to free his daughter, but fails, and the bandits demand a ransom. Meanwhile, the silk dealer goes to a Shaolin temple, and trains to learn Mantis kung fu.

programme.title: A Fighters Journey
programme.desc: By 2008 Jonathan Brookins was already a seasoned fighter, having faced UFC champion Jose Aldo. His good looks, golden dreadlocks and sharp intellect, made him a fight fan favorite. But when Brookins was crowned the Ultimate Fighter after winning the 12th Season UFC Finale, what is fans didn't know is that he was facing a much tougher opponent outside the cage... himself. Drugs and alcohol together with an eating disorder had taken it's toll on Brookins.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Leo Fong
programme.desc: Filmmaker, martial arts legend, Leo Fong was one of the early pioneers of martial arts in America. From judo to jiu jitsu to choy lay fut to wing chun to Shaolin styles, Fong helped open the doors of the arts to a new generation. A former champion boxer, he was the first to introduce unique forms for weight training to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Mean Streets of Kung Fu
programme.desc: When challenged by a local gangster, a top martial arts student (Barry Chan) proves his skill and determination and defeats the thug. Now it's open warfare and fierce battles between the forces of good and evil.

programme.title: Fearless Dragons aka Two on the Road
programme.desc: A shipment of gold is stolen, and two transients are blamed. This sets the stage for a major action adventure, with some of the best names in the genre. Kung Fu superstars Philip Ko and Leung Kar Yan play the leads. They face off against Wang Lung Wei, in what many consider one of the best end fights in history. Years later, all involved said this film took something out of them! A Times Square favorite: true action.

programme.title: Dance of Death
programme.desc: Kung fu girl, Angela Mao tricks two equally matched kung fu masters who duel every five years into teaching her both of their styles so she can take revenge against a vicious gang that killed her friends. The teachers stand by during her fights and count the number of moves that she uses to defeat her enemies so they can prove which of them is superior. This is one of the best choreographed Angela Mao movies, and is recommended for viewing by all Angela Mao fans.

programme.title: One Shot, One Life
programme.desc: In traditional martial arts, mastery of the art is not acquired through technical skill alone. In following 'The Way' one must look beyond technique to become a true master. In Japanese archery or Kyudo, hitting the target by itself is not enough. To shoot correctly we are told to "Shoot from the Heart". As Takeuchi sensei says "As a national team member I had to hit the target no matter what. Eventually all that technique became obsolete in exchange to express myself through the bow".

programme.title: Art of the Japanese Sword
programme.desc: The Japanese sword ... prized as much for its exceptional beauty as for its deadly cutting ability. It has endured for a thousand years as the pinnacle of Japanese culture. Now you can enter a world rarely seen by outsiders. To experience the true story of the Art of the Samurai Sword. A story told in the swordsmiths own words that separate the myth from the fact. Follow the swordsmiths dream of creating a masterpiece.

programme.title: Shaolin Chastity Kung Fu
programme.desc: After the massacre of a small village, a group of survivors led by Ah Tien are trained by a mysterious monk. They train in the arcane secrets of Tong Zi Kung. Soon they decide to avenge their loved ones against the Nine Devil Gang.

programme.title: Ninja Champion
programme.desc: Two Interpol agents, Donald and George, are on the trail to smash up an international diamond smuggling gang. But the leader of the gang is determined to destroy them at all cost and evokes his evil ninja powers to corrupt and destroy all those who stand in his way.

programme.title: Eagle vs Silver Fox
programme.desc: After the downfall of the Manchu Dynasty, the surviving officials plan to restore order across China. One of these men, Silver Fox, hires the best fighters in the country to assassinate those who were responsible for the revolution and destroy all martial arts schools. To combat this menace the various schools band together and nominate Chow Fung, master of the Eagle form, to face the might of the Silver Fox in a one-on-one bone-breaking showdown.

programme.title: Masters of Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Experience a Tai Chi Chuan class with Master Cui Zhongsan in Beijing and listen to him explain the history and philosopy of Yang style and how and why it developed as a seperate style from Chen Tai Chi. Visit the small remote Chen village, the birthplace of Tai Chi and learn the history of Tai Chi with the Chen family. It was here that Yang style was born through Chen student Yang Luchan.

programme.title: Champ Against Champ
programme.desc: Tinfeng, the leader of the Devil's Gate bandit gang in the North has ambitions to rule the entire country, but meets fierce resistance from Pak and his armies. When Pak is attacked by Tinfeng's Powerful Lions, his son in laws, only hope for justice is crippled. Dragon must learn the 18 kicks technique to overcome a multitude of traps and challenges before he can face Tinfeng for the final showdown.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio paga la fianza de Mecha y, al salir, ella no puede parar de hacerle preguntas, pero la prioridad es saber quién es él. Se muerde los labios, ella está tentada a decirle la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Zambrana ya ha esperado demasiado y exige a Fernando que atente contra la vida de Ismael, es hora de liquidarlo. "Vitaminas" identifica a Tracy Lobo, espera la orden de Casillas para disparar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes de enfrentar a los atacantes de Ismael, Aurelio le pide a Corina que lo acompañe, aunque no les conviene que los vean juntos. "La Felina" se une a los Casillas con armas y hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio reúne a la familia y ordena mantenerse alertas, después de la masacre. Rutila le hace una advertencia a su padre que no tiene vuelta atrás. Casillas ya sabe cómo rescatar a Bere.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana, aún consciente de provocar un disgusto, le pone a Aurelio Casillas una condición de último minuto antes de entregarse a la DEA. Roberta le confiesa a Mecha su atracción por las mujeres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas le ordena al gobernador, Jaime Rosales, parar el operativo de la DEA e impedir la extradición de Diana. La detenida recibe una oferta de Alfaro que implica una traición sin medida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una banda de criminales busca a Mecha para borrarla del mapa, al enterarse de que es ella quien ayuda a los migrantes a huir. "Vitaminas" le informa a Casillas que su mujer está bajo amenaza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina roba información, tiene una pista que es clave para Aurelio y sus deseos de venganza; él no deja de pensar en Mecha, cree que ella es la indicada, tiene en mente viajar a Mexicali.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las cosas van demasiado lejos, Corina sufre por Aurelio, pero lo prometido es deuda. Fernando allana el terreno con Rutila, va de frente y una rosa roja le arranca una sonrisa al día siguiente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha intenta terminar su relación con Aurelio, tanta violencia no le hace gracia. Él le compra una lujosa residencia, lo único que quiere es protegerla, responde a todas sus preguntas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio vuelve a escuchar a Mecha y los motivos por los cuales ella no quiere estar con él, le susurra al oído un deseo que la haría muy feliz, pero el miedo la congela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aguirre avanza en su objetivo, victimizarse lo empuja a los brazos de Rutila, Javi está donde él quiere, lejos y en el blanco, como un hombre celoso capaz de todo, hasta de liquidar a su mujer.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con el apoyo de "Vitaminas", Aurelio se cuela en las oficinas de Aguirre, debe averiguar de dónde vino el pitazo para el ataque a su hija, más vale que lo consiga. Javi no está en la ecuación.
programme.sub-title: Lo vas a pagar con sangre

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tracy haciéndose pasar por "La Soberana" consigue lo que buscaba, se encuentra con los Casillas, quiere conocer a Aurelio y lavar dinero para ellos. Rutila, a regañadientes, viaja con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de conocer a Mecha, Rutila le advierte a Aurelio que ella le oculta algo; sabe que como mujer no podría vivir sin él, pero a la vez huele peligro si sigue con Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Berenice no cree que Jaime sea un asesino, Diana intenta protegerla, pero ella más bien se siente secuestrada y le recuerda a su hermana que aún sigue casada con Rosales.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tracy Lobo como "La Soberana" tiene un solo objetivo, engañar a Casillas y atraparlo. Aurelio lanza una pregunta que la pone a prueba, los nervios pueden traicionarla y quedar al descubierto.
programme.sub-title: Por la boca muere el pez

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina está a punto de darle la mejor pista a Aurelio, pero la atacan por la espalda. Colón y Castillo intimidan a Saade para que se convierta en un informante de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio siente la presencia de Doña Alba, tiene una profunda conversación con ella, quien le recomienda mirar hacia el pasado, preguntarse para qué tanto poder y cuidar lo que hace actualmente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javi asume que fue un patán con Rutila, no hay otra mujer a la que haya querido tanto, le advierte que, si no la libra, recuerde siempre sus labios. La hija de Casillas está angustiada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jaime se va de aventuras con Dalila, quien lo ayuda a experimentar al extremo, pero la diversión se acaba cuando Alfaro interrumpe la velada para citarlo en su oficina de emergencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha se queda en Mexicali y esperará a Aurelio, no quiere vivir en medio de la guerra, pero él corre a atender la desaparición de Corina. La Soberana queda obsesionada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio e Ismael salen a buscar a Corina, ella respira profundo e intenta sobrevivir en medio de la selva, pero antes, Casillas, que sabe cómo lograr lo que quiere, le hace una promesa a Mecha.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Celos a la tercera edad; Cobrando mi maltrato

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Asociación A.M.A; Manager lucra de videos porno

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alicia pide terapia para su esposa Andrea, ella practica una extraña y peligrosa danza japonesa. Carlos quiere desalojar a Lázaro, él lo mandó a prisión y se quedó con su casa y con su hermana.
programme.sub-title: Danza Butoh; Romeo y Julieta callejeros

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula es adicta a la crema de mentol y la usa en todo su cuerpo, pero la crema le causó daño a su esposo y ahora él la demanda. Fabiola se convirtió al cristianismo y por eso le pide el divorcio a su pareja.
programme.sub-title: Amor al mentol; Todo es gracias a Dios

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por haberle transmitido sida, Sara le pide 500 mil dólares a Geovanny y la lista de las personas con las que ha tenido sexo. Claudia lo ataca con un machete, él la demanda por 50 mil dólares.
programme.sub-title: Va contagiando VIH; Babalawo recibe machetazos de esposa

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana descubrió que su padre está muerto y no la abandonó como su madre dijo. También se dio cuenta de que esta ya se gastó toda la herencia que dejó el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana dice que su esposo cambió cuando la vio parir, ella cree que él es gay. Ahora pide la custodia de su hija y 25 mil dólares. Cynthia despide a César por fumar marihuana, él pide ser indemnizado.
programme.sub-title: Traumado por ver a mujer parir; Marihuana o deshabilitado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián desea emanciparse de su mamá Andrea, quien vive con un sicario involucrado en el crimen de su padre. Carlos planea ir a Puerto Rico a vengar la muerte de su amigo, pero su esposa se opone.
programme.sub-title: El hijo del sicario; Muerte segura

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina averiguó que su esposo toma fotos de los hombres en los baños públicos, por lo que desea separarse. Danilo supo por Facebook que tiene un hijo y trata de detener el proceso para darlo en adopción.
programme.sub-title: Ver en el baño inspira; Papá por Facebook

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alonso pretende la custodia de una de las hijas mellizas de Antonio y Mariana. Sofía requiere que Michelle desaloje su casa porque se ha hecho adicta a olfatear los condones con semen.
programme.sub-title: Mellizas con diferentes padres; Látex contra el cigarrillo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Renata estaba embarazada de gemelos con un donante de esperma, pero uno de los bebés nació muerto y ahora se pelean por el otro. Rolando teme que su sobrina mate a su madre, por eso pide que se vaya.
programme.sub-title: Mi bebé murió, quiero el tuyo; Mi sobrina Génesis

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maritza se entera de que su novia tuvo sexo con 364 hombres, por eso la demanda y cancela la boda. La mujer de Luis quiere el divorcio porque por culpa de él casi se electrocuta su hija.
programme.sub-title: Heterosexual por un año; Anguila, el electricista

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos pide una orden de alejamiento contra su esposa, quien mantiene una papa en la vagina. Juan solicita la custodia de su hijo porque su pareja es satanista y teme por su salud física y mental.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.
programme.sub-title: Madre e hija disputan hijo; Misma casa 4 inquilinos desalojados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.
programme.sub-title: Niña insatisfecha con su vagina; Anchón ayudando a otros niños

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny fue despedido por no complacer el acoso sexual de su jefa; ahora exige una compensación. Ignacio golpeó a su esposa, lo grabaron y publicaron el video; él demanda a quien lo hizo.
programme.sub-title: Perdí papeles por sexo; Atleta golpea esposa

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Helen se niega a darle la residencia en EE. UU. a su hija; el papá de la niña, Felipe, la demanda para obligarla. América pide emanciparse porque descubrió que su madrastra es la amante de su hermano.
programme.sub-title: La hija de la mula; Testamento infame

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una artista dona su cadáver para exponerlo en una galería de arte, pero su marido Luciano intenta impedirlo. Luis quiere quitarle la custodia de su hermana con síndrome de Down a su enfermera Libia.
programme.sub-title: Donación post mortem para arte; La lucha por Sabrina

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marian exige que Gary interne a su hermana, pero él alega que Emily solo necesita unión familiar. A Karla le traumatizaba el tráfico, quiso cambiar de horario y fue despedida; ahora exige una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un mago quiere desalojar a su aprendiz por revelar muchos trucos. Una adolescente está embarazada, pero tiene cáncer. Sus padres debaten si salvar la vida del futuro bebé o la de su hija.
programme.sub-title: Dúo de magia; Hija con cáncer y embarazada

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina enviudó y se casó con Franco. Pero el esposo de Paulina reapareció y ahora Franco los demanda. Federico es minusválido y sufre de erecciones. Elizabeth se aprovechó y se embarazó, pero ahora Federico reclama al bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raquel necesita ser parte de la vida de su hijo con Roberto, pero este dice que no porque el niño es producto de un incesto. Tania es una ex luchadora que quiere volver al ring, pero su hijo se opone.
programme.sub-title: Hijo de mi hermano no; Luchadora para salvar hijo
